reserveReview.rationale: Write-time re-open 2026-07-28: the prior transfero.com/wp-content/.../daily-report.pdf URL returns 404. The live BRZ product page now links a Reserve report PDF at framerusercontent.com that still presents BRZ as redeemable 1:1 for reais, reports R$15,243,944.24 collateral against R$12,398,003.00 circulating, and states the reserve is held in custody at a financial institution authorized by the Central Bank of Brazil, dated March 31, 2024 18:00 BRT. The product page independently states each BRZ is backed 1:1 with BRL with redemption via regulated partners. No institution name, account terms, or newer composition report was found. Modeled as one 100% BRL bank-deposit slice.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Transfero BRZ transparency report dated March 31, 2024 (re-hosted URL from live product page)
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The issuer discloses a single authorized-institution BRL reserve category but not the institution name, account terms, liquidity terms, segregation, or a report more recent than March 31, 2024.
